parables.title: The Sower
parables.summary: Seed falls on4 different types of soil (path, rocks, thorns, good soil), representing how4 different types of people receive the word of God.

parables.title: The Weeds (Tares)
parables.summary: An enemy sows weeds among wheat; the owner allows them to grow together until harvest to avoid destroying the wheat.

parables.title: The Mustard Seed
parables.summary: The Kingdom of God starts small like a tiny seed but grows into a large tree.

parables.title: The Leaven (Yeast)
parables.summary: A small amount of leaven permeates a large batch of dough, illustrating the expansive influence of the kingdom.

parables.title: The Hidden Treasure
parables.summary: A man sells everything he has to buy a field containing hidden treasure.

parables.title: The Pearl of Great Price
parables.summary: A merchant sells all his possessions to purchase one exceptionally valuable pearl.

parables.title: The Net
parables.summary: A net gathers all kinds of fish, which are later sorted into good and bad, representing the end of the age.

parables.title: The Unforgiving Servant
parables.summary: A servant who was forgiven a huge debt refuses to forgive a fellow servant a small debt, resulting in punishment.

parables.title: The Workers in the Vineyard
parables.summary: Workers hired at different times of the day all receive the same pay, illustrating God's sovereign grace.

parables.title: The Two Sons
parables.summary: A son says he won't work but does, while another says he will but doesn't, highlighting that actions matter more than words.

parables.title: The Wedding Banquet
parables.summary: Guests refuse an invitation to a wedding feast, so the host invites people from the streets instead.

parables.title: The Ten Virgins
parables.summary: Five wise virgins have oil for their lamps, while five foolish ones do not, emphasizing readiness for Christ's return.

parables.title: The Talents
parables.summary: Servants are entrusted with resources; those who invest them are rewarded, while the one who hides his is punished.

parables.title: The Sheep and the Goats
parables.summary: Jesus separates people based on how they treated the vulnerable, equating service to them with service to Him.

parables.title: The Growing Seed
parables.summary: A farmer scatters seed and it grows secretly without his understanding, representing God's work in the heart.

parables.title: The Two Debtors
parables.summary: A person forgiven a greater debt loves more than one forgiven a smaller debt.

parables.title: The Good Samaritan
parables.summary: A despised Samaritan helps a wounded man, unlike the religious figures who ignored him.

parables.title: The Friend at Midnight
parables.summary: A man persists in asking his neighbor for bread, teaching the need for persistence in prayer.

parables.title: The Rich Fool
parables.summary: A man builds bigger barns for his wealth but dies before enjoying them, highlighting the folly of storing earthly riches.

parables.title: The Barren Fig Tree
parables.summary: A fig tree that bears no fruit is given a final chance before being cut down.

parables.title: The Great Banquet
parables.summary: Excuses are made by invited guests, so the host opens the banquet to all, including the marginalized.

parables.title: The Lost Sheep
parables.summary: A shepherd leaves 99 sheep to find one that is lost, rejoicing when it is found.

parables.title: The Lost Coin
parables.summary: A woman searches diligently for a lost coin, celebrating with neighbors when she finds it.

parables.title: The Prodigal Son
parables.summary: A son squanders his inheritance but is welcomed back with open arms by his loving father.

parables.title: The Unjust Steward
parables.summary: A dishonest steward prepares for his future, prompting a lesson on using earthly resources for eternal gain.

parables.title: The Rich Man and Lazarus
parables.summary: A selfish rich man goes to torment, while a poor beggar named Lazarus goes to heaven.

parables.title: The Persistent Widow
parables.summary: A widow persists in asking a judge for justice until he grants it.

parables.title: The Pharisee and the Tax Collector
parables.summary: A proud Pharisee and a humble tax collector pray; the latter is justified for his humility.

parables.title: The Minas
parables.summary: Servants are given minas (money) to manage until their master returns, rewarding those who were productive.

parables.title: The Wicked Tenants
parables.summary: Tenants kill the owner's son, illustrating how religious leaders rejected Jesus.
